ITM-9001.explanation: SAMPLE: = stores the value on the right under the name on the left. It does not compare and does not print.

option_explanations.c: Nothing is printed until print() is called.

ITM-9002.explanation: SAMPLE: names may contain letters, digits and _, but cannot start with a digit; - means subtraction.

option_explanations.a: A name cannot start with a digit.

ITM-9003.explanation: SAMPLE: the right-hand side score + 5 is worked out first using the old value 10, giving 15, which is stored back in score.

option_explanations.a: score was given a new value on line 2.
option_explanations.c: print shows the value, not the expression.

ITM-9004.explanation: SAMPLE: 4 > 10 is False, so the if block is skipped and the else block runs.

option_explanations.c: Only one of the two blocks runs.
